title: Scalability Analysis of Distributed Kolmogorov-Arnold Network Training on High-Performance Computing Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.07740v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) replace the fixed activation functions and linear weights of Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) with learnable univariate functions on network edges, offering improved interpretability and, in some settings, competitive parameter efficiency. While the approximation properties of KANs have received considerable attention, their behavior under distributed, multi-GPU training has not been systematically characterized. This paper presents an empirical scalability study of data-parallel KAN training on multi-node, multi-GPU high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure, evaluated along four dimensions: strong scaling, weak scaling, communication overhead, and model-size scaling.   Experiments were conducted on the FinisTerrae III supercomputer using up to 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs across 4 nodes with PyTorch Distributed Data Parallel (DDP). translated_title: 高性能计算系统上分布式Kolmogorov-Arnold网络训练的可扩展性分析
translated_abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）用网络边上可学习的单变量函数取代了多层感知机（MLPs）的固定激活函数和线性权重，提供了更好的可解释性，并且在某些设置下具有有竞争力的参数效率。虽然KANs的逼近性质已受到广泛关注，但其在分布式多GPU训练下的行为尚未得到系统性的表征。本文对多节点、多GPU高性能计算（HPC）基础设施上的数据并行KAN训练进行了实证可扩展性研究，从四个维度进行评估：强扩展性、弱扩展性、通信开销和模型规模扩展。实验在FinisTerrae III超级计算机上进行，使用PyTorch分布式数据并行（DDP），跨4个节点最多使用8块NVIDIA A100 GPU。KAN训练在8个GPU上达到74.7%的并行效率，加速比达5.97倍。
tldr: 本文首次系统性地研究了Kolmogorov-Arnold网络在多节点多GPU高性能计算系统上的数据并行训练可扩展性，实验表明在8个GPU上可实现74.7%的并行效率和5.97倍加速。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic empirical study of data-parallel Kolmogorov-Arnold Network training scalability on multi-node, multi-GPU HPC systems, achieving 74.7% parallel efficiency and 5.97x speedup with 8 GPUs.
